title: DATA ENGINEER - H/F - LYON
description:
Intégré(e) au sein de la practice Data Engineering à Lyon, vous intervenez sur des projets à fort enjeu pour nos clients de la région Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes :
 Architecture et ingestion : concevoir, développer et maintenir des pipelines de données robustes et scalables (batch et temps réel).
 Modern Data Stack : déployer et administrer des environnements Cloud (GCP, AWS ou Azure) et des entrepôts de données modernes (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks).
 Transformation et qualité : modéliser les données, automatiser les flux (dbt, Airflow) et garantir la gouvernance, la sécurité et la fiabilité des livrables.
 Conseil et transmission : accompagner les équipes métiers et techniques de nos clients, animer des ateliers et contribuer aux communautés internes AVISIA (veille, retours d'expérience, R&D).
 Formation : diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieurs ou d'un Master 2 en informatique / Data.
 Expérience : vous justifiez d'au moins 2 ans d'expérience en Data Engineering (les profils confirmés et seniors sont également les bienvenus).
 Stack technique :
 Maîtrise de Python et SQL .
 Expérience significative sur au moins un environnement Cloud ( GCP , AWS ou Azure ).
 Connaissance des outils d'orchestration et de transformation ( Airflow , dbt , Spark ).
 Sensibilité aux bonnes pratiques CI/CD , Git , Docker et Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
 Savoir être : curiosité technique, esprit d'équipe, sens du service et capacité à vulgariser des sujets complexes auprès d'interlocuteurs variés.

title: Master Data Engineer
description:
About Vitestro
 Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.
 By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.
 At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.
 Master Data Engineer
 As our Master Data Engineer, you own the accuracy and integrity of the master data behind every Aletta we build: items, bills of materials (BOMs), revisions and routings in our ERP system. You translate the engineering BOM released by R&D into the manufacturing BOM for products, sub-assemblies and spare parts. You also own the change control process between Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain, from the first change request to the verified change in the build. This is a newly created role in our Operations team.
 First months at Vitestro
 In your first months, your focus will be on two things. First, you set up the change process end to end: from an engineering change to its implementation in the build, including the impact on time and cost. You register changes, organize the impact assessment with Operations, Supply Chain and Quality, chair the change review board, and define effectivity and the disposition of existing stock. description:

We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.
Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.
 The Role
 The Advanced Insights and Modeling (AIM) team is a high-impact, business-savvy group of builders: machine learning engineers, data scientists, data engineers, and business strategists who combine technical skills with deep product and financial expertise. We hold high standards, move fast, and own our models end to end. AIM runs on curiosity, bold thinking, and collaboration, and we keep the culture decidedly non-corporate. Teams across Block come to us when they need insight, speed, and real business impact.
 AIM sits within Block’s Foundational organization and is sponsored directly by the CFO, but our mandate runs well beyond Finance.
